title: NHRC Guidelines on Dowry Harassment Cases — Police Accountability
content:
NHRC issued guidelines requiring:
1. Women's Help Desks at every police station.
2. A female police officer must be present during recording of statement    of a woman complainant.
3. Police must inform the woman of her rights under DV Act + BNS 85 +    Dowry Prohibition Act simultaneously.
4. One Stop Centres (OSCs) must be referred to victim for shelter/support.
PRACTICAL: If police refuse these facilities, file complaint with NHRC and State Human Rights Commission.
